items.headline: IMDA fines Singtel S$1 million over March mobile outages that hit 720,000 subscribers
items.summary: The Infocomm Media Development Authority fined Singtel S$1 million on Oct 20 over three mobile service disruptions in March that affected about 720,000 subscribers. Singtel accepted the ruling.

items.headline: COE premium for smaller cars climbs to S$132,004, edging past the larger-car category
items.summary: In the second October bidding exercise that closed on Oct 21, the Category A premium rose S$2,003 to S$132,004, overtaking Category B at S$131,901.

items.headline: Former SAF captain jailed 17 months for sexually abusing a teenage boy
items.summary: Former army captain Chaw Chia Jun, 41, was jailed 17 months on Oct 20 after pleading guilty to sexually abusing a 15-year-old boy and producing child-abuse material.

items.headline: Two Singaporean women charged over the alleged abuse of domestic workers
items.summary: Two women, aged 49 and 50, were charged in separate cases on Oct 19 over the alleged abuse of domestic helpers. The allegations have not been proven.

items.headline: Singapore and Qatar agree to work towards a strategic partnership on PM Wong's visit
items.summary: During an official visit on Oct 18-20, PM Lawrence Wong and Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim agreed to work towards a strategic partnership and co-chaired their high-level joint committee for the first time in 20 years.

items.headline: Update: India's Supreme Court takes up the mass voter-roll challenge as ~133 million names are struck
items.summary: India's Supreme Court is taking up a challenge to a sweeping revision of electoral rolls that critics say has removed about 133 million names, alongside cases over mass detentions during weeks of protests.

items.headline: Update: Reliance's Jio Platforms opens India's largest rupee IPO as anchor bids top US$26 billion
items.summary: Reliance's Jio Platforms opened its roughly US$3.2 billion IPO on Oct 21, priced at 1,065-1,119 rupees a share. Its anchor book drew bids worth US$26.3 billion, valuing the group at about US$108 billion.

items.headline: Sitharaman says India's fundamentals are sound as foreign investors pull US$32.5 billion from stocks
items.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said India's fundamentals remain strong even as benchmark indices have fallen around 12% this year and foreign investors have pulled about US$32.5 billion from Indian equities in 2026.

items.headline: Rupee climbs to a six-week high as Jio IPO inflows and RBI measures lift the currency
items.summary: The rupee strengthened about 0.5% on Oct 21 to 94.45 per dollar, its firmest since late June, lifted by inflows into the Jio IPO and Reserve Bank measures to curb dollar demand.

items.headline: UK approves the Jackdaw North Sea gas field, reviving a project a court had quashed
items.summary: The UK government approved development of the Jackdaw gas field in the North Sea on Oct 21, reviving a Shell-linked project a Scottish court had quashed over its climate impact. Ministers said it could raise domestic gas output by about 6% at its peak.

items.headline: UK inflation jumps to 3.5% in September, hardening Bank of England rate-hike expectations
items.summary: UK inflation rose to a hotter-than-expected 3.5% in the year to September, up from 3.1% in August and above the 3.4% forecast, driven largely by motor-fuel costs.

items.headline: Chancellor Healey rules out a capital-gains-tax rise in the 28 October Budget
items.summary: Chancellor John Healey will not raise capital gains tax in the Oct 28 Budget, Bloomberg reported, with a bank levy seen as the more likely revenue measure. The higher CGT rate currently stands at 24%.

items.headline: Bank of England's Greene urges a November rate rise as officials split over inflation risk
items.summary: Bank of England rate-setter Megan Greene urged colleagues to lean against inflation with a rate rise at the early-November meeting, while Deputy Governor Sarah Breeden struck a more cautious note on a soft labour market.

items.headline: Putin agrees 'in principle' to resume three-way Ukraine peace talks after meeting US envoy Witkoff
items.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed in principle to resume US-Russia-Ukraine peace talks after meeting US envoy Steve Witkoff in St Petersburg on Oct 21. Moscow also freed detained American Stephen Hubbard during the visit.

items.headline: UN food agency halves Gaza rations and cuts those it feeds to 1.1 million
items.summary: The UN World Food Programme said funding shortfalls forced it to halve food rations in Gaza and cut the number it supports to 1.1 million in October, from 1.6 million in September, with two-thirds of the population facing crisis-level hunger.

items.headline: Israel heads to its 27 October election with polls pointing to a stalemate
items.summary: With Israel's election set for Oct 27, polls point to a deadlock in which neither bloc reaches the 61-seat majority, and Gadi Eisenkot's new party running level with or narrowly ahead of Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud.

items.headline: Iran rules out surrendering its enriched-uranium stockpile as tensions rise
items.summary: A senior Iranian security official said Iran will not give up its stockpile of enriched uranium as war odds rise, though Al Jazeera reported Tehran may consider diluting the material at home under monitoring.

items.headline: Nvidia releases new open-weight 'Nemotron' models for enterprise and on-device AI agents
items.summary: Nvidia launched a new family of open-weight Nemotron models built for AI agents running in enterprises and on PCs, TechCrunch reported, including a 120-billion-parameter system.

items.headline: Recursive launches Flint, a free laptop-sized coding model it says was largely built by AI
items.summary: AI startup Recursive released Flint on Oct 21, a free coding model small enough to run on a laptop that it says was built largely with the help of AI, available on Hugging Face under an open licence.

items.headline: Nscale nears a ~US$45 billion deal to supply Anthropic computing power from West Virginia
items.summary: Data-centre firm Nscale is in talks for a deal worth almost US$45 billion to supply Anthropic with computing power from a new West Virginia facility using Nvidia chips, Bloomberg reported.

items.headline: Meta lifts its 2026 AI capital-spending outlook to as much as US$145 billion
items.summary: Meta raised the low end of its 2026 capital-spending outlook to US$135-145 billion, underscoring its AI build-out, as third-quarter revenue beat estimates and it guided Q4 revenue to US$73-76 billion.

items.headline: Tesla tops Q3 estimates but net profit falls 29% as car prices slip
items.summary: Tesla posted Q3 revenue of US$28.05 billion and adjusted earnings of 48 cents a share, beating estimates, but GAAP net income fell 29% to US$787 million as automotive revenue slipped 3% to US$20.56 billion.

items.headline: Musk says Tesla and SpaceX form committees to explore a merger
items.summary: Elon Musk said the boards of Tesla and SpaceX have each formed special committees to study a possible combination he called a good idea, though no terms have been agreed. SpaceX shares jumped more than 8% after it reported Q3 revenue of US$14.58 billion.

items.headline: Netflix beats on Q3 profit but shares fall about 7% on a trimmed outlook
items.summary: Netflix reported Q3 earnings of 87 cents a share on revenue of US$12.87 billion, up 12%, with operating margin at 34.6%. Shares fell about 7% after it trimmed its full-year revenue outlook to US$51.1 billion and cut its advertising forecast.

items.headline: IBM beats Q3 estimates on software strength
items.summary: IBM reported Q3 revenue of about US$17.1 billion, up 5% and ahead of estimates, with adjusted earnings of US$2.95 a share as software revenue grew 8%.

items.headline: Traders expect the Fed to hold rates at its 27-28 October meeting
items.summary: Markets are pricing in the US Federal Reserve leaving interest rates at 3.75%-4% at its Oct 27-28 meeting, even after a hotter September inflation reading, with the 10-year Treasury yield easing on soft housing data.

items.headline: Antonelli can clinch his first F1 title at this weekend's US Grand Prix
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli can seal his first Formula 1 world championship at the US Grand Prix in Austin (23-25 Oct), arriving on 340 points, 102 clear of George Russell and 111 ahead of Lewis Hamilton.

items.headline: Pakistan beat England by 87 runs in their ODI tri-series clash in Rawalpindi
items.summary: Pakistan beat England by 87 runs on Oct 20 in their ODI tri-series match in Rawalpindi, posting 302 for 9 before bowling England out for 215.

items.headline: India Women complete a 3-0 T20I sweep of Zimbabwe Women
items.summary: India Women wrapped up a 3-0 Twenty20 series sweep of Zimbabwe Women, winning the final match in Raipur on Oct 20 by 92 runs. Captain Harmanpreet Kaur was named player of the match.

items.headline: Tsitsipas and Khachanov advance at the Almaty Open
items.summary: Stefanos Tsitsipas and fifth seed Karen Khachanov advanced into the next round at the Almaty Open, the ATP 250 indoor-hard event in Kazakhstan, where Daniil Medvedev is the top seed.

items.headline: Quarter-finals take shape at the WTA Ningbo Open
items.summary: The last eight is forming at the WTA 500 Ningbo Open in China, with Paula Badosa, Mirra Andreeva and Beatriz Haddad Maia among the players through to the quarter-finals.

items.headline: Expedition to a remote Pacific island finds no fresh clues to Amelia Earhart's plane
items.summary: An expedition to the remote Pacific island of Nikumaroro found no conclusive evidence that wreckage there came from Amelia Earhart's aircraft, leaving the 1937 disappearance unresolved.

items.headline: A Neanderthal at Shanidar Cave may have been killed by a spear 75,000 years ago
items.summary: Archaeologists studying Shanidar Cave in Iraq suggest a Neanderthal known as Shanidar A may have been killed by a wooden thrusting spear about 75,000 years ago, though the cause of death could not be confirmed.

items.headline: A new extinct crocodile is identified in the limestone that built the Great Sphinx
items.summary: Researchers identified a new extinct crocodile, named Herugavialis after the god Horus, from a fossil cut from the same limestone used to build the Great Sphinx and dating to roughly 45 million years ago.

items.headline: A strengthening 'super' El Nino is on track to set an all-time intensity record
items.summary: A strengthening El Nino is on course to set an all-time intensity record by December, according to CNN's reading of NOAA data, with scientists expecting 2026 and 2027 to rank among the warmest years.

fun_fact.headline: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid
fun_fact.body: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the first Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid of Giza. The pyramid was completed around 2560 BC, more than 2,500 years before Cleopatra's death in 30 BC, while the Apollo 11 landing came less than 2,000 years after her. The Egypt of the pyramid-builders was already ancient history in her own lifetime.

puzzle.title: Roll With It
puzzle.body: A standard six-sided die (opposite faces add to 7) starts with 1 on top, 2 facing north, 3 facing east. It is tipped onto its side four times: east, north, east, north. Which number ends up on top?
puzzle.approach: Track only top, north and east; each hidden face is 7 minus its opposite.

word_puzzle.title: Mixed Messages
word_puzzle.body: Each phrase is an anagram of a single related word: DIRTY ROOM; VOICES RANT ON; THE CLASSROOM.
word_puzzle.approach: Count letters, then find a same-length word the phrase describes.
